researchLinks.description: We Found Eight Attack Vectors Inside AWS Bedrock. Here's What Attackers Can Do with Them

securityImplications: Attackers might use UpdateFlow to inject a malicious S3 or Lambda node into a Bedrock flow's data path, routing sensitive data to attacker-controlled infrastructure or executing attacker code mid-workflow.
